universal_patterns.pattern: this chapter shall apply to (?:any|every|all|the following)\b[^.]*
regulation be imposed upon a profession or occupation
enter into a profession or occupation
a profession or occupation shall be regulated
any bill that proposes to regulate a profession or occupation
any bill to materially amend the scope of practice
regulatory law that is within its jurisdiction

proposal.rationale: Vermont Title 26 has two umbrella-style chapters: Chapter 57 (telehealth, §§ 3051-3052) which enumerates specific health care professions, and Chapter 59 (§§ 3101-3108+) which contains the OPR general policy/review framework that genuinely applies to every regulated profession or occupation in Vermont. The chapter 59 sections (Policy, Definitions, Process for review, Criteria, Director's report, Information required of applicants, Preliminary assessment) all use the framing "a profession or occupation" generically and govern OPR's review of all regulatory laws. To capture these, we add chapter-level universal patterns matching phrases like "regulation be imposed upon a profession or occupation", "a profession or occupation shall be regulated", "all boards and advisor professions", and "any bill that proposes to regulate a profession or occupation". We keep narrow "this chapter shall apply to..." patterns for chapter 57. We deliberately do NOT add bare "as used in this chapter" as universal since that's handled by the walker's cross-state AS_USED_RE.
